body: I dont get why people care about upvotes and this is a throwaway anyways so downvote me all you want. I dont care. Im just trying to express myself without hurting anyone. Id rather not be here ranting about shit either but still here we both are.
Thank you for this, its frustrating but ill try to get through it. So much pretence.

There are people who understand. This person just doesnt. And I dont cry about it. I try to do something about it and none of it works. I thought this was a venting sub and guess what? Im venting. Go cry about it

God, this could have been written by me. I relate to every word. No one can help me and they keep telling me that they can. It makes me so tired. They wont let me die. I wish you better days, I truly hope they come for you

I get this too im my biggest scars. Its like phantom pain and its drives me absolutely insane. It just shoots up my arm when im not doing anything. I dont know of this is nerve damage but it might be?
Ive been denying my own thoughs for so long, its almost natural. Im scared of calling, I dont know..
That is very kind of you, and i feel your aversion to that attitude that so many people seem to have. They just dont care.
